theme._comment: Optional. Omit this whole block to use the default navy/cream theme. Any key left out falls back to default. Hex colors only.

skiInstructions._comment: Optional — only used by ski-in/ski-out properties. Omit this whole block otherwise. Image filenames refer to properties/<slug>-<name>.<ext> files, which build.sh copies in automatically.

thingsToDo._comment: Optional — a seasonal activities section. Omit entirely if not needed.

favoriteRestaurants._comment: Optional — same shape as localRecommendations items, but rendered as its own flat section instead of grouped under Neighborhood Spots.

communityCenter._comment: Optional — for properties with access to a shared community center/clubhouse. Omit otherwise.
